title: In-Place Home Resale: One Open Resale File per Seller
content:
**Resident desk guidance — In-Place Home Resale.** A resale file covers one home on one site, and a seller may have 1 open resale file at a time. A new resale file is opened for a seller only where the seller has no other resale file in opened, listed or under-contract status. A file that has closed as sold, been withdrawn or expired does not count, so a seller whose listing expired may open a new file.

**Basis of the judgement.** The count is taken from the company's resale file records for that seller, before the new file is opened; what the seller says about earlier files does not replace those records.

| Status of the seller's other resale file | Counts as an open file | New file may be opened |
|---|---|---|
| opened | yes | no |
| listed | yes | no |
| under contract | yes | no |
| closed as sold | no | yes |
| withdrawn | no | yes |
| expired | no | yes |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical sellers)

- A seller whose only earlier file expired last spring has no open file: a new file may be opened.
- A seller with one file withdrawn and another listed has an open file (the listed one): no new file is opened while it stays listed.
- A seller with no earlier resale file at all has no open file: a new file may be opened.
